statement: Pinned Linux sound/usb/mixer_quirks.c identifies DualSense as UAC1 and creates read-only Headphone Jack and Headset Mic Jack indicators from hid-playstation events associated by shared USB-device ancestry. This is established consumer behavior, but it does not establish physical terminal type codes, actual jack/mute/volume operation on a hardware unit, or that independent UHID and PipeWire sidecars inherit a common USB parent. Physical jack/control fidelity therefore remains unknown.

applicability.scope: Device-fidelity gap informed by pinned Linux USB-audio consumer source. The kernel's declared UAC1 and jack/USB-ancestry implementation is not a corpus device experiment; no hardware or host run.
